prose: Coverage of Liquid AI's LFM3 launch for on-device AI: a natively multimodal family (text, vision, audio) in a compact footprint with open weights, backed by AMD for Ryzen AI processors and Qualcomm for Snapdragon, with enablement on Ambarella silicon underway.
The headline benchmark: LFM3-1.7B beat Qwen3.5-2B on 65 everyday agent tasks in real macOS environments, 64% to 48% task success, using 58% fewer tokens.
highlights: Second-source coverage of the LFM3 on-device launch
Multimodal open weights for AI PCs and edge devices
1.7B model beats Qwen3.5-2B 64/48 on real Mac agent tasks
AMD, Qualcomm and Ambarella platform support
